newsitem.title: UK: No election announcement this week - UK's Major.
newsitem.headline: No election announcement this week - UK's Major.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said in an interview published on Thursday that he would not announce the date of Britain's general election this week.
There has been intense speculation that Major might name the date at or before his ruling Conservative party's semi-annual conference this Friday and Saturday in Bath, western England.
But in an interview with the Western Daily Press, Major said: "There will be no announcement at or before Bath. I am not going to speculate beyond that."

Major said he wanted to remove what he called "artificial speculation" about an announcement at or before the weekend.
The paper said Major refused to be drawn on whether he would announce the date of the election next week.
Asked if polling would be on May 1, he replied: "I am not going to give any indication one way or another."
